description: The identical command on firmware 89fc095, where both ADCs had been moved to the PWM on-time trigger. Reads essentially no current.
notes: Phase current 0.0035 A RMS — 200x below the reference.
Duties still correct at 0.500 +/- 0.090 and v_d exactly 1.500 V: the modulator was fine, only the measurement was blind.
Real current was flowing throughout. The low-side shunts simply carry none at the sample point, because they conduct only at the counter peak.
